findings.detail: The nonaccrual count includes three comparative-period debt rows, producing seven flagged rows instead of the four current-period rows whose cost totals the 38.05 million current non-accrual schedule amount.

rationale: The current-period non-accrual schedule reports amortized cost of 38.05 million. The current SOI rows bearing the non-accrual footnote are Streamland 6.428 million, MedeAnalytics Parent 6.057 million, Pluralsight 14.160 million, and Thrasio 11.402 million, which sum to 38.047 million and round to the schedule total. The flagged artifact counts seven rows by also including comparative-period MedeAnalytics, Pluralsight, and Thrasio rows from the 2024 SOI section, so the flag is a real data error caused by comparative-period leakage.
